items.title: Bloom Energy Soars 13%, Vertiv Up 14% in a Week as Data-Center Fears Ease
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 13% in the past week, with Vertiv and Oracle, after CoreWeave and Constellation Energy raised their 2026 guidance. Bloom had no news of its own, and with its orders and rising estimates intact, the bounce looks like it has further to go.

items.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Debuts PowerNexus MV UPS For AI Data Centers
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) introduced the PowerNexus MV UPS, a medium-voltage power system for AI data centers, focusing on grid integration and outdoor deployment. The PowerNexus MV UPS is designed for use with long-duration battery systems, targeting power-hungry AI compute clusters that strain existing electrical infrastructure.
